current_grouping: Subpart H — Command and Control Data Link
canonical_title: Command and control data link loss strategy

versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart H — Command and Control data link
versions.title_at_revision: Command and control data link loss strategy
versions.text:
See AMC.1613 (a), AMC.1613 (b) and AMC.1613 (c)
(a) A command and control data link loss strategy must be established, approved and presented in the UAV System Flight Manual taking into account the emergency recovery capability as defined in USAR.1412.
(b) The command and control data link loss strategy shall include an autonomous reacquisition process in order to try to re-establish in a short reasonable time the command and control data link.
(c) There must be an alert for the UAV crew, via a clear and distinct aural and visual signal, for any total loss of the command and control data link.
